tasks.label: HealthFlow: start local site
tasks.command: $nodeRoot = Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\WinGet\Packages\OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS_*\node-v*-win-x64" -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName; if ($nodeRoot) { $env:Path = "$nodeRoot;$env:Path" }; $response = try { Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:3001/' -TimeoutSec 2 -UseBasicParsing } catch { $null }; if ($response -and $response.StatusCode -eq 200) { Write-Host 'HealthFlow is already running at http://localhost:3001' } else { npm.cmd run dev -- --port 3001 }
